note: condensed from the Higgsfield result by Claude; visuals shortened, audio lines verbatim

scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: A rhythmic, high-pitched vocalizing sound, reminiscent of a comical scream or a 'woo' sound, repeating at a fast tempo.
scenes.visual: hand with black polka-dot nails holds matte olive green case, two tiny frogs inside; bedroom with blurred American flag and string lights

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: The high-pitched 'woo' sounds continue, synced with the action of picking up the earbud.
scenes.visual: right hand picks up the LEFT frog earbud; frog sits on a dark green silicone ear tip

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: frog earbud held between thumb and index finger, static, shallow depth of field

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: The vocal 'woo' sounds increase in intensity and frequency.
scenes.visual: blonde woman outdoors in profile, hoop earrings, pearl necklace, beige trench; places the frog earbud into her LEFT ear

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: The vocalizations continue at a steady, upbeat tempo.
scenes.visual: she turns to camera and smiles widely, earbud visible

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: The 'woo' sounds continue, but slightly muffled to simulate the background noise of an airplane.
scenes.visual: airplane cabin: blonde woman in pink hoodie, eyes closed; muscular man in black tank top leans in to look closely at her ear

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: The high-pitched vocalizing reaches a crescendo and ends abruptly with a final 'woo' sound.
scenes.visual: man reacts with exaggerated shock, mouth wide open, hands raised; woman opens her eyes, confused
